decisions.reason: Close to the established pipeline-components business and publicly presented on its own page, so sunk costs and visible commitment make dropping unlikely while weak results can still be seen as temporary.
Distant from the core offer with limited investment and only a small public footprint, so after three years disappointing results can no longer be attributed to temporary causes.
Distant from the established business with little sunk cost or public commitment, making it hard to justify continued persistence after sustained disappointing results.
As a niche, distant product with low investment and no strong public commitment, the firm has little reason to keep absorbing losses once temporary explanations fade.
